# Remove all data first
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ranger) # randomFroest faster alternative
library(tictoc) # measure time
library(tidyverse) # data cleaning and plotting
```

# data cleaning process
```{r}
# Keep row of required transformations aside first
df <- read_csv("../data/cleaned_fred2.csv") %>% filter(year >= 1985)
test_dataset <- df %>% filter(sasdate >= "2015-01-01")
### --- Define our target variables: 1-month inflation rate and 3-month cumulative inflation rate --- ###
df1 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Monthly inflation rate
    inflationRate_1m = 100 * (log_coreCPI - lag(log_coreCPI, 1)),
    # Next month's inflation
    inflationRate_1m_future = lead(inflationRate_1m, 1),
    # 3-month cumulative inflation
    inflationRate_3m = 100 * (log_coreCPI - lag(log_coreCPI, 3)),
    # 3-month-ahead cumulative inflation
    inflationRate_3m_future = lead(inflationRate_3m, 3),
    # 6-month cumulative inflation
    inflationRate_6m = 100 * (log_coreCPI - lag(log_coreCPI, 6)),
    # 6-month-ahead cumulative inflation
    inflationRate_6m_future = lead(inflationRate_6m, 6),
    # 12-month cumulative inflation
    inflationRate_12m = 100 * (log_coreCPI - lag(log_coreCPI, 12)),
    # 12-month-ahead cumulative inflation
    inflationRate_12m_future = lead(inflationRate_12m, 12)
  ) %>%
  select(-c(CPILFESL, log_coreCPI, log_lagcoreCPI, inflationRate, sasdate, year, month, 
            inflationRate_1m, inflationRate_3m, inflationRate_6m, inflationRate_12m)) %>% 
  as.matrix()

rownames(df1)<- as.character(df$sasdate) # set the column name for readability
```

# Run the Random Forest
```{r, echo=FALSE}
set.seed(123) # for consistent replication, not sure if this is needed here
window.number <- 127 # used later to signify number of rolling window operations

# Running Random Forest
# Quick guide: df1 refers to the dataset, window.number is the number of rolling windows conducted, the third argument refers to the indice where the inflationrate column is, the last argument is to generate the different step forecases

tic() 
source("random forest (ranger).R")# load the functions
onemonth <- which(colnames(df1) == "inflationRate_1m_future")
threemonth <- which(colnames(df1) == "inflationRate_3m_future")
sixmonth <- which(colnames(df1) == "inflationRate_6m_future")
twelvemonth <- which(colnames(df1) == "inflationRate_12m_future")
rf1c=rf.rolling.window(df1,window.number,onemonth) # 1-step forecast
rf3c=rf.rolling.window(df1,window.number,threemonth) # 3-step forecast
rf6c=rf.rolling.window(df1,window.number,sixmonth) # 3-step forecast
rf12c=rf.rolling.window(df1,window.number,twelvemonth) # 3-step forecast
toc() # measures the time taken, anywhere between 2-4 mins
```

# run the DM test and RMSE

```{r}
dates <- as.Date(rownames(df1))
rmse.rf1c <- sqrt(mean((rf1c$actual - rf1c$pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse.rf3c <- sqrt(mean((rf3c$actual - rf3c$pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse.rf6c <- sqrt(mean((rf6c$actual - rf6c$pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
rmse.rf12c <- sqrt(mean((rf12c$actual - rf12c$pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

mae.rf1c <- mean(abs(rf1c$actual - rf1c$pred), na.rm = TRUE)
mae.rf3c <- mean(abs(rf3c$actual - rf3c$pred), na.rm = TRUE)
mae.rf6c <- mean(abs(rf6c$actual - rf6c$pred), na.rm = TRUE)
mae.rf12c <- mean(abs(rf12c$actual - rf12c$pred), na.rm = TRUE)
cat("1m  RMSE:", rmse.rf1c, " MAE:", mae.rf1c, "\n")
cat("3m  RMSE:", rmse.rf3c, " MAE:", mae.rf3c, "\n") 
cat("6m  RMSE:", rmse.rf6c, " MAE:", mae.rf6c, "\n")
cat("12m RMSE:", rmse.rf12c, " MAE:", mae.rf12c, "\n")
```
# Save results 
```{r}
rf_results <- list(
  rf_1m = rf1c,
  rf_3m = rf3c,
  rf_6m = rf6c,
  rf_12m = rf12c,
  data_info = list(
    n_forecasts_1m = sum(!is.na(rf1c$pred)),
    n_forecasts_3m = sum(!is.na(rf3c$pred)),
    n_forecasts_6m = sum(!is.na(rf6c$pred)),
    n_forecasts_12m = sum(!is.na(rf12c$pred)),

  )
)
```

# plot graph
```{r}

# make time series data frame
start_date <- as.Date(test_dataset$sasdate[1])
end_date <- as.Date(test_dataset$sasdate[nrow(test_dataset)])

timeseries.1month =ts(cbind(rf1c$actual, rf1c$pred), 
                         start = c(as.numeric(format(start_date, "%Y")),
                        as.numeric(format(start_date, "%m"))),
              end = c(as.numeric(format(end_date, "%Y")),
                      as.numeric(format(end_date, "%m"))),freq=12)


timeseries.3month =ts(cbind(rf3c$actual, rf3c$pred), 
                         start = c(as.numeric(format(start_date, "%Y")),
                        as.numeric(format(start_date, "%m"))),
              end = c(as.numeric(format(end_date, "%Y")),
                      as.numeric(format(end_date, "%m"))),freq=12)

# Create a sequence of dates for monthly data
dates <- seq(from = start_date, to = end_date, by = "month")

# Convert to data frame for ggplot
df_plot_1month <- data.frame(
  Date = dates,
  TrueValue = as.numeric(timeseries.1month[, 1]),
  RandomForest = as.numeric(timeseries.1month[, 2])
)

df_plot_3month <- data.frame(
  Date = dates,
  TrueValue = as.numeric(timeseries.3month[, 1]),
  RandomForest = as.numeric(timeseries.3month[, 2])
)

# plot the graphs

# 1-step ML forecasts
ggplot(df_plot_1month, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = TrueValue, color = "True Value"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = RandomForest, color = "Random Forest"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("True Value" = "black", "Random Forest" = "blue")) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "6 months") +  
  labs(title = "1-step ML forecast",x = "Date",y = "CPI Inflation",color = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 3-step ML forecasts
ggplot(df_plot_3month, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = TrueValue, color = "True Value"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = RandomForest, color = "Random Forest"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("True Value" = "black", "Random Forest" = "blue")) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "6 months") +  
  labs(title = "3-step ML forecasts",x = "Date",y = "CPI Inflation",color = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
